scope: For every fixed compact connected Hermitian background with zero lower Monge--Ampere mass, an explicit positive-radius ball of smooth probability log-densities around log(h^n/(V_h*dV)) in C^(2,alpha), 0<alpha<1, has unique exact Gauduchon maximizing currents with uniformly bounded probability and determinant densities in Linfinity and therefore at n/(n-1). The family is infinite dimensional, contains distinct data with distinct exact maximizers, and imposes no bounds on higher derivatives. Broader continuous or large bounded families remain open.

source.report:
All four exact premise strings are established. For premise 0, I reconstructed the stated Hölder-space version from Oh’s compact-manifold Sobolev Fredholm theorem, Dyatlov’s smooth-kernel result, and Simon’s interior Schauder estimates. Closed-range duality and distributional elliptic regularity identify the cokernel with smooth solutions of the formal adjoint relative to dμ. Differentiation, interpolation, and a finite coordinate cover give the stated higher-order Schauder estimates, including the C^{s,α}-coefficient interior variant. [Oh, Proposition 10.1.13](https://cgp.ibs.re.kr/~yongoh/all.pdf), [Simon, Lecture 12](https://math.stanford.edu/~lms/lecs-on-pde.pdf).

Premise 1 follows from Cass’s Theorem 7.1, localized in manifold charts. Premise 2 follows from local constancy of the Banach-space Fredholm index; the Laplace–Beltrami index is zero because its kernel and adjoint kernel coincide, with the Hölder realization preserving these smooth kernels. [Cass](https://www.math.ubc.ca/~cass/research/pdf/FS.pdf), [Analysis on Manifolds, Theorem 1.5.2](https://www.staff.science.uu.nl/~ban00101/geoman2017/AS-2017.pdf).

Premise 3 matches the c≤0 strong maximum principle, with the minimum formulation obtained by replacing v with −v. Its applications to L_h and the shifted adjoint have the required ellipticity and signs. [MIT, Lecture 6, Theorem 4](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/18-156-differential-analysis-spring-2004/d9e0f047d5682a70799331a926d27a11_lec6.pdf). No positive lower Monge–Ampère mass hypothesis is required by these external results.

passages.statement: Let M be a compact smooth manifold without boundary, dμ a smooth positive density, 0<α<1, and s a nonnegative integer. Let P be a real scalar second-order differential operator with smooth coefficients and uniformly positive-definite symmetric principal coefficient matrix. Then P:C^{s+2,α}(M)→C^{s,α}(M) is Fredholm, its kernel consists of smooth functions, and its range is exactly the set of f satisfying ∫_M f p dμ=0 for every smooth p with P* p=0, where P* is the formal adjoint relative to dμ. Moreover, ||v||_{C^{s+2,α}}≤C(||Pv||_{C^{s,α}}+||v||_{C^0}) for a constant determined by P, M and the fixed norms. The analogous interior Schauder estimates hold on coordinate domains for uniformly elliptic operators whose coefficients belong to C^{s,α}.

source.report:
Both exact external premise strings are independently established. Cass’s Theorem 7.1 applies to the distributional coefficient ρ: A_ω has smooth coefficients and elliptic principal symbol when ω is smooth and positive, and A_ωρ=0 has smooth right-hand side. [Cass](https://www.math.ubc.ca/~cass/research/pdf/FS.pdf).

The mean-value log-determinant operator used to distinguish F_s and F_t has smooth positive-definite principal coefficients and no zeroth-order term. Its solution attains a maximum on compact connected X, so the stated strong maximum principle applies. [MIT, Lecture 6, Theorem 4](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/18-156-differential-analysis-spring-2004/d9e0f047d5682a70799331a926d27a11_lec6.pdf). No conclusion of the other note was used as external evidence. This verdict approves the supplied external premises; completion of the uniform-estimate task is a separate check.

primary_source_audit.root_interior_schauder_cross_assessment: Simon gives the complete constant-coefficient lemma for k=2m and the freezing/absorption argument in divergence form. For nondivergence order two, freeze a^{ij} at the ball center, apply that same k=2 constant-coefficient lemma to a compactly supported cutoff of u, and estimate the error (a(center)-a(x))D2u by its small oscillation times the highest Holder seminorm plus the bounded coefficient Holder seminorm times the D2u supremum. Interpolation absorbs the latter and cutoff first derivatives. A finite cover yields the C0-term estimate. Differentiating the equation gives higher-order estimates for C^(s,alpha) coefficients; no smooth-density argument in full Holder norm is required. The paper uses the separately read Taylor smooth-coefficient parametrix mapping for its two inverse maps and Taylor nonlinear regularity for its smooth bootstrap.

root_math_assessment: Compact elliptic compatibility gives a positive normalized baseline factor and two bounded inverse maps. Two quantitative contractions solve the nonlinear volume equation and the normalized adjoint-factor equation in an explicit small smooth C^(2,alpha) ball. Stokes and matrix arithmetic-geometric mean prove exact maximality against every singular or smooth current test; equality and distributional elliptic regularity identify all exact maximizers. Trace-normalized formulas give separate uniform Linfinity and critical bounds for the probability density q and determinant density k. Normalized smooth variations give an infinite-dimensional family on the same assumed zero-lower-mass background, and a nonscalar Hessian path gives distinct exact maximizing currents. The article adds the full-Holder Fredholm passage, a barrier proof of the maximum principle, precise primary references and direct weak-adjoint/supporting identities. No estimate for arbitrary continuous bounded or large families is asserted.
